description: 官方预训练DETR-R50在三张真实照片及其变体上的实际CPU推理记录。没有重新训练模型。

protocol.display_rule: best nonempty class probability; no NMS
protocol.lowres: shortest48 bilinear then restore original size
protocol.occluded: constant gray rectangle x35%-65%,y18%-82% of image; covers19.2% area
protocol.timing_scope: model forward only, excludes download/loading/preprocessing; illustrative CPU observation
protocol.metric: target maximum class probability is confidence, not accuracy; no complete GT so do not compute AP or recall
protocol.classes: COCO official indices with unused91class positions +empty in checkpoint
